notes.title: SLING PUZZLE: GRAVITY MASTER - Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are happy to announce the release date of SLING PUZZLE: GRAVITY MASTER, available February 21th, 2024!

We are all very excited for the community to get their hands on the game. We appreciate all the feedback we have received. It’s been fun and invaluable to listen to everyone’s ideas and suggestions, we couldn’t have done it without your help!

Much love!
- Hap Games
